name: Vortex-ring crop sprayer
subtitle: a sprayer that fires pesticide in smoke rings

effects.effect: a sharp puff rolls into a spinning ring that travels far without spreading

effect: a sharp puff rolls into a spinning ring that travels far without spreading
how: Much of the pesticide farmers spray drifts off on the wind, poisoning neighbours and streams instead of pests. This sprayer loads a small cloud of droplets into a box and punches it out as a spinning ring, which holds its droplets together like a smoke ring and carries them metres deep into a tree's leaves before breaking up, so far less spray is needed and little escapes.
obstacle: Crosswinds and dense foliage can tear the rings apart early, and nobody knows yet how many droplets a ring can carry before it falls apart.
why: Spray drift harms health and wastes chemicals; rings deliver it where blowers scatter it.
